training_window.policy: All training races strictly precede the five-day test window. Same-day results are not used to predict another race on that date.

data_source.final_odds_policy: Official confirmed final odds are retrospective market benchmark only; they are not model input.

sequential_learning_evaluation.policy: Walk-forward by Japan-local race date. Each day's model is refit using only official race results strictly before that date. Prior test-day results are added to the next day's training set; same-day results are not used until the next date.

C_performance_pace.rank_gap_definition: market rank minus LAB rank; positive means LAB ranks the horse higher
C_performance_pace.comparison_policy: LAB and market ranks are recomputed on the same horses with valid official final odds in each race; outcomes are official finishing positions.

integrated_strategy_E.policy: Fixed 0.30 calibrated top-win probability gate; role-specific trifecta ranking blend 0.10; 2-3-4 formation. The reference uses the same qualifying races and formation with ordinary ranking, isolating the ranking change. Parameters are not selected on the holdout fold.

feature_update.body_weight: Six-axis challenger compares current declared weight with the horse's strictly prior five recorded weights; missing history is neutral.
feature_update.frame: Frame number is read from the official NAR frame-number field and contextualized by venue, surface, distance and field size.
feature_update.running_style_and_pace: Escape/stalker/closer/deep-closer profiles are inferred from strictly prior corner positions; today's field pace is estimated before the race.
feature_update.finish_time_and_last3f: Comparable time-per-kilometre, margin quality and race-relative last-3F rank are retained as separate performance-quality inputs.
feature_update.opponent_strength: Six-axis challenger adjusts prior performance for the pre-race ability of opponents; opponent estimates are frozen before each race date is committed.
feature_update.production_policy: New six-axis challenger remains research-only pending holdout validation; the existing chronological live scorer uses the listed pace, time, last3f, opponent, body-weight, and frame history inputs.

limitations: The new body-weight and opponent-strength axes remain research-only until independent holdout results justify promotion.
Five calendar days are a short sample; results are diagnostic and cannot establish stable hit rate or profitability.
The comparison uses official final odds as a retrospective market benchmark, not as a pre-off input.
D4 is research-only; no live model weights, saved predictions, or production tickets are changed.
